text: Cancellations happen every day. The waitlist turns a lost hour into a visit for a family who wanted to come in sooner.
Tom Chen would like something sooner. Keep the visit, and add him to the waitlist.
The family and pet are filled in.
The one thing to remember: when a visit cancels, check the waitlist before the slot goes to waste.
Add anything that helps: best times, who to call.
On the Waitlist, the card shows how soon, the visit they already have, and who they'd like to see.
When a visit cancels, pick the doctor and the date of the opening here. Families that fit move to the top.
Recommend slot searches that doctor's day for the family.
Pick the doctor and visit type, and search. Routing checks each open time against the day's drive, so it takes a few seconds.
Book it if you have the family on the phone. Otherwise, text them the offer. That's the next video.
For a family that already has a visit, Recommend slot opens Explore alternatives, so their visit stays until the new time is confirmed.

The most common mistakes: letting a cancelled slot sit empty, and adding a family without saying how soon they can come. Remember: when a visit cancels, check the waitlist before the slot goes to waste.
